async def act(page):
    """
    Find the most recent cancelled order in the Orders grid and print the customer name (Bill to Name).
    """
    import re
    import asyncio

    # Knowledge-base helper functions review (not used):
    # - generate_sales_summary_for_date_range: dashboard-only, not useful for Orders grid filtering
    # - export_dashboard_snapshot: dashboard-only, not useful
    # - export_orders_csv: exports dashboard "Last Orders" widget, not the full Orders grid
    # - export_customers_csv_via_grid: exports Customers grid, unrelated
    # None of the KB helpers provide a direct way to filter the Orders grid by status and extract
    # the most recent cancelled order, so we interact with the Orders UI directly.

    # Ensure we're on the Orders page (use relative path)
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales_order/')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(700)

    # If a dismiss/close button for a popup is present, try to close it (best-effort).
    try:
        # Look for any obvious close/dismiss button by accessible name
        close_btns = page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"^(close|×|x|dismiss)$", re.I))
        if await close_btns.count() > 0:
            await close_btns.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    except Exception:
        # ignore if not present or not clickable
        pass

    # 1) Find the combobox that contains an option whose visible text contains 'cancel' (case-insensitive)
    target_combobox = None
    target_option_label = None

    comboboxes = page.get_by_role("combobox")
    cb_count = await comboboxes.count()
    for i in range(cb_count):
        cb = comboboxes.nth(i)
        options = cb.get_by_role("option")
        opt_count = await options.count()
        for j in range(opt_count):
            opt_txt = (await options.nth(j).inner_text() or "").strip()
            if "cancel" in opt_txt.lower():
                target_combobox = cb
                target_option_label = opt_txt
                break
        if target_combobox:
            break

    if not target_combobox:
        # Couldn't find a status-like combobox with a cancel option
        print("")
        return

    # 2) Select the 'Canceled' option by exact visible label when possible
    try:
        await target_combobox.select_option(label=target_option_label)
    except Exception:
        # fallback: select by value attribute for the matched option
        options = target_combobox.get_by_role("option")
        for j in range(await options.count()):
            opt = options.nth(j)
            txt = (await opt.inner_text() or "").strip()
            if "cancel" in txt.lower():
                val = await opt.get_attribute("value")
                if val is not None:
                    await target_combobox.select_option(value=val)
                break

    # 3) Click the Search button scoped to the same row / controls as the combobox
    try:
        controls_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=target_combobox).first
        # Use the full path to the button inside the controls row
        await controls_row.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
    except Exception:
        # fallback to page-level Search button
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first.click()
        except Exception:
            print("")
            return

    # Allow results to refresh
    await page.wait_for_timeout(900)

    # 4) Find the first Status cell that contains 'cancel' and scope its parent row
    status_locator = page.get_by_role("cell", name=re.compile(r"cancel", re.I))
    if await status_locator.count() == 0:
        # No cancelled orders found
        print("")
        return

    canceled_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=status_locator.first).first

    # 5) Extract the Bill to Name cell (commonly the 5th cell, index 4)
    cells = canceled_row.get_by_role("cell")
    total = await cells.count()

    customer_name = ""
    if total > 4:
        try:
            customer_name = ((await cells.nth(4).inner_text()) or "").strip()
        except Exception:
            customer_name = ""

    # 6) Fallback heuristics if needed
    if not customer_name:
        for i in range(total):
            txt = ((await cells.nth(i).inner_text()) or "").strip()
            if not txt:
                continue
            if re.search(r"cancel", txt, re.I):
                continue
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\d\s,.$€£¥%\-]+", txt):
                continue
            if any(c.isalpha() for c in txt) and " " in txt:
                customer_name = txt
                break
        if not customer_name and total > 0:
            for i in range(total):
                txt = ((await cells.nth(i).inner_text()) or "").strip()
                if txt and not re.search(r"cancel", txt, re.I):
                    customer_name = txt
                    break

    # Print the exact discovered customer name (or empty string if none found)
    print(customer_name)

    """
    import re
    import asyncio

    # Knowledge-base helper functions review (not used):
    # - generate_sales_summary_for_date_range: dashboard-only, not useful for Orders grid filtering
    # - export_dashboard_snapshot: dashboard-only, not useful
    # - export_orders_csv: exports dashboard "Last Orders" widget, not the full Orders grid
    # - export_customers_csv_via_grid: exports Customers grid, unrelated
    # None of the KB helpers provide a direct way to filter the Orders grid by status and extract
    # the most recent cancelled order, so we interact with the Orders UI directly.

    # Ensure we're on the Orders page (use relative path)
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales_order/')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(700)

    # If a dismiss/close button for a popup is present, try to close it (best-effort).
    try:
        # Look for any obvious close/dismiss button by accessible name
        close_btns = page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"^(close|×|x|dismiss)$", re.I))
        if await close_btns.count() > 0:
            await close_btns.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    except Exception:
        # ignore if not present or not clickable
        pass

    # 1) Find the combobox that contains an option whose visible text contains 'cancel' (case-insensitive)
    target_combobox = None
    target_option_label = None

    comboboxes = page.get_by_role("combobox")
    cb_count = await comboboxes.count()
    for i in range(cb_count):
        cb = comboboxes.nth(i)
        options = cb.get_by_role("option")
        opt_count = await options.count()
        for j in range(opt_count):
            opt_txt = (await options.nth(j).inner_text() or "").strip()
            if "cancel" in opt_txt.lower():
                target_combobox = cb
                target_option_label = opt_txt
                break
        if target_combobox:
            break

    if not target_combobox:
        # Couldn't find a status-like combobox with a cancel option
        print("")
        return

    # 2) Select the 'Canceled' option by exact visible label when possible
    try:
        await target_combobox.select_option(label=target_option_label)
    except Exception:
        # fallback: select by value attribute for the matched option
        options = target_combobox.get_by_role("option")
        for j in range(await options.count()):
            opt = options.nth(j)
            txt = (await opt.inner_text() or "").strip()
            if "cancel" in txt.lower():
                val = await opt.get_attribute("value")
                if val is not None:
                    await target_combobox.select_option(value=val)
                break

    # 3) Click the Search button scoped to the same row / controls as the combobox
    try:
        controls_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=target_combobox).first
        # Use the full path to the button inside the controls row
        await controls_row.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
    except Exception:
        # fallback to page-level Search button
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first.click()
        except Exception:
            print("")
            return

    # Allow results to refresh
    await page.wait_for_timeout(900)

    # 4) Find the first Status cell that contains 'cancel' and scope its parent row
    status_locator = page.get_by_role("cell", name=re.compile(r"cancel", re.I))
    if await status_locator.count() == 0:
        # No cancelled orders found
        print("")
        return

    canceled_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=status_locator.first).first

    # 5) Extract the Bill to Name cell (commonly the 5th cell, index 4)
    cells = canceled_row.get_by_role("cell")
    total = await cells.count()

    customer_name = ""
    if total > 4:
        try:
            customer_name = ((await cells.nth(4).inner_text()) or "").strip()
        except Exception:
            customer_name = ""

    # 6) Fallback heuristics if needed
    if not customer_name:
        for i in range(total):
            txt = ((await cells.nth(i).inner_text()) or "").strip()
            if not txt:
                continue
            if re.search(r"cancel", txt, re.I):
                continue
            if re.fullmatch(r"[\d\s,.$€£¥%\-]+", txt):
                continue
            if any(c.isalpha() for c in txt) and " " in txt:
                customer_name = txt
                break
        if not customer_name and total > 0:
            for i in range(total):
                txt = ((await cells.nth(i).inner_text()) or "").strip()
                if txt and not re.search(r"cancel", txt, re.I):
                    customer_name = txt
                    break

    # Print the exact discovered customer name (or empty string if none found)
    print(customer_name)
    return total
